 Order No.02 Date: 10.08.2023
1.

The present writ petition has been filed for issuance of direction upon the respondents to follow the procedure of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter to be referred as 'the Act, 2013') for acquisition of the petitioner's land appertaining to Khata no.20, plot no.04 measuring an area of 1.20 acres, Village Bande, Thana no.41, P.S. Murhu, District Khunti.

Further prayer has been made Sandeep Kumar Dodray vs The State Of Jharkhand on 10 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172115938/
1 for issuance of direction upon the respondents to pay adequate compensation to the petitioner for unlawfully occupying the said land.

entities.text: Sandeep Kumar Dodray vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the land in question originally belonged to Mandru Pahan and others and the same has been recorded in the revisional survey record of rights.
Thereafter, the aforesaid land came in exclusive possession of Mandru Pahan after partition among other co-sharers.
After the death of Mandru Pahan, his three sons, namely, Sohrai Pahan, Soma Pahan and Sanika Pahan came in exclusive possession of the land in question.

They amicably partitioned the aforesaid land and after partition, the land in question fell in the share of Sanika Pahan, who died leaving behind his three sons, namely, Bhola Pahan, Soma Dodray and Rali Pahan.
Soma Dodray also died leaving behind his two sons, namely, Sandeep Kumar Dodray (the petitioner herein) (Sandeep Dodray as mentioned in paragraph no.8 of the writ petition) and Tnaneswar Dodray.
At present, the petitioner (grandson of Sanika Pahan) is in peaceful possession over the land in question.

3. It is further submitted that the aforesaid land was taken by the respondents for the period from 1957 to 1964 for the purpose of agriculture exhibition and to demonstrate the use of chemical manure/ fertilizer as also modern farming system.

However, after completion of the said period, the possession of the aforesaid land was taken back by the ancestors of the petitioner and since then the petitioner/his forefathers have been farming over the same.

Recently, the respondents asked the petitioner to vacate the said land and they forcefully dispossessed him from his land for construction of 'Farmers School' as well as execution of various projects without following due procedure of law as laid down under the Act, 2013.
The petitioner represented the Deputy Commissioner, Khunti- respondent no.2 ventilating his grievance, but the same was not responded, which has compelled him to file the present writ petition.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner also submits that similar writ petition being W.P.(C) No.4023 of 2023 (Galay Dodray Vs. The state of Jharkhand & Ors.) has already been disposed of by this Court vide order dated 2 nd August, 2023 and, therefore, the present writ petition may also be disposed of in terms with the said order.

entities.text: W.P.(C) No.4023 of 2023 (Galay Dodray Vs. The state of Jharkhand & Ors.)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Mr. P.C. Sinha, learned A.C. to G.A.III, appearing on behalf of the respondents submits that the petitioner has not annexed any document suggesting restoration of the land in question in favour of his forefather immediately after 1964.

Otherwise also, the petitioner's claim is required to be factually verified by a competent authority and, therefore, if the petitioner files a fresh representation before the District Land Acquisition Officer, Khunti-respondent no.5 in this regard,
an appropriate decision will be taken within a timeframe.

6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the nature of the prayer made in the writ petition, without entering into merit of the case, the petitioner is given liberty to file a fresh representation along with relevant documents on the present issue before the respondent no.5.

On receipt of the said representation, the respondent no.5 on verifying the relevant records and on providing opportunity of hearing to the petitioner/his representative shall take an appropriate informed decision within eight weeks from the date of filing of the same.
